entities.name: Q2NW88
observations: Reviewed Sodalis glossinidius phosphatidylserine decarboxylase proenzyme; the query sequence is an exact 100%-coverage match.
Catalyzes phosphatidylserine conversion to phosphatidylethanolamine and CO2 (EC 4.1.1.65; Rhea RHEA:20828).
UniProt annotation reports a covalently bound pyruvoyl group per subunit.
